notas: Plan 1

Manhã: 1) Prep the fresh bits: Chop the cherry tomatoes into halves or quarters and place them in your bowl.
2) Add the crunch: Roughly crush or chop the walnuts and drop them in with the tomatoes along with the pitted black olives.

3) Combine the seafood: Gently flake the sardines and tear the anchovy fillets into bite-sized pieces. Add them straight to the bowl, using a tiny splash of the remaining oil from the tin as a natural dressing.

4) Balance the flavours: Squeeze over a generous wedge of fresh lemon juice—this cuts right through the salty, rich oiliness of the anchovies and sardines—and scatter over the fresh parsley and black pepper.

5) Toss and serve: Give everything a gentle mix so the tomato juices blend with the lemon and olive oil. Eat as is, or spoon it right off the plate for an instant, high-protein Mediterranean breakfast.

notas: PREPARE THE YOGURT BASE: Spread 100g of FAGE 5% Greek yogurt across the bottom of your shallow bowl. Add a tiny squeeze of fresh lemon juice and a pinch of salt, then smooth it out with the back of a spoon.
WARM THE CHICKPEAS: Take 120g of cooked chickpeas (from 50g raw cooked ahead, or canned) and warm them gently in a small pan or microwave for 30 seconds.
ASSEMBLE THE BOWL: Spoon the warm chickpeas over the cool yogurt base. Slice 1 hard-boiled egg in half and nestle it right alongside the chickpeas.

DRESS AND SEASON: Drizzle the 0.5 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil evenly over the warm chickpeas, egg, and yogurt. Finish with a generous pinch of salt, freshly cracked black pepper, and an extra squeeze of fresh lemon juice over the top.

*FRIED VERSION: Heat your tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, crack in the three eggs, season generously with salt, black pepper, and dried oregano, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are deliciously crispy and golden; slide the eggs onto your plate, drizzle over any warm olive oil left in the pan, and top with your crushed walnut for a rich, savoury breakfast ready in minutes.

*BOILED VERSION: Bring a small pot of water to a rolling boil, gently lower in the three eggs, and cook for 6 to 7 minutes for soft, jammy yolks (or 9 minutes for a firm hard-boil), then immediately drain and peel them under cold water; slice the eggs in half, arrange them on your plate, drizzle the full tablespoon of olive oil directly over the warm yolks alongside a pinch of sea salt, black pepper, and oregano, and crumble the walnut over the top for a quick, zero-fuss meal.

notas: 1) MASSAGE THE ROCKET: Place your rocket into your serving bowl, add a light squeeze of fresh lemon juice and a tiny pinch of salt, and gently toss it with your fingers. Pro-tip: Salting and dressing the rocket first breaks down its natural bitterness and makes it far more enjoyable.

2) SEASON THE TOMATOES: Halve the cherry tomatoes and place them directly on top of the rocket. Sprinkle a small pinch of salt and black pepper straight onto the cut sides of the tomatoes to draw out their sweet juices.

3) TEAR, DON'T CUT: Tear the half-ball of fresh mozzarella and the Parma ham into rustic, bite-sized pieces using your hands rather than cutting them with a knife. Torn edges have more surface area, which catches the dressing much better than smooth, clean cuts.

4) DRESS AND FINISH: Scatter the torn mozzarella and Parma ham over the salad. Drizzle the full tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil and another light squeeze of lemon juice evenly over the top. Finish with a final crack of black pepper or a dash of dried oregano. Eat immediately so the rocket stays crisp!

notas: COOK THE BASE: Combine the 15g oat bran, 15g Scottish porridge oats, and 300ml Gold Top milk in a microwave-safe bowl or small saucepan. Heat on high for 2 minutes (or simmer on the stove for 3–4 minutes), stirring halfway through until thick and creamy.

DISSOLVE THE COLLAGEN: Remove the porridge from the heat while it is piping hot, sprinkle in the 5g of collagen peptides, and stir thoroughly for 10–15 seconds until completely dissolved into the warm oats.
ADD THE BLUEBERRIES: Stir in the 80g of blueberries straight away. The heat from the porridge will cause the berries to burst slightly, releasing their naturally sweet juices right through the oats.

ELEVATE THE FLAVOUR: Finish with a tiny pinch of salt (essential to enhance the richness of the Gold Top milk) and a dash of ground cinnamon or a drop of vanilla extract if you have them on hand. Serve immediately!

notas: Receita:

Descasque e cozinhe a Abóbora Cabotiá e a Batata Inglesa até ficarem macias ao furar com um garfo. Escorra a água, reservando uma pequena quantidade.

Bata a abóbora e a batata cozidas no liquidificador (ou amasse-as muito bem), adicionando um pouco da água do cozimento reservada até atingir a consistência de sopa desejada.

Em uma panela separada, aqueça o azeite em fogo médio. Refogue a cebola picada e o alho até dourarem e liberarem aroma.

Adicione o peito de frango cozido e desfiado à panela e misture bem com o alho, a cebola e o azeite.

Despeje o creme batido de abóbora e batata na panela com o frango. Mexa bem para incorporar.

Tempere com sal e pimenta-do-reino, deixando ferver em fogo brando por 3 a 5 minutos para apurar os sabores.

Sirva quente, finalizando com cheiro-verde fresco por cima.
Dica de Preparo:
Para render os 115g de peito de frango cozido e desfiado exigidos na receita, utilize aproximadamente 150g de peito de frango cru.

notas: 1) Pique bem a cebola, o alho e o tomate. Corte o brócolis e a couve-flor em pequenos buquês. Rale a cenoura e fatie a couve manteiga.
2) Na panela, aqueça o azeite de oliva e refogue o alho e a cebola até dourarem.
3) Adicione o tomate picado e refogue até ele desmanchar e formar uma base saborosa.
4) Acrescente a cenoura, o brócolis e a couve-flor. Cubra com água fervente, tempere e deixe cozinhar em fogo médio por cerca de 15 minutos, até os vegetais estarem macios.
5) Adicione o peito de frango desfiado e a couve manteiga fatiada. Misture bem e deixe ferver por mais 3 minutos para apurar o sabor.
6) Transfira a sopa para um prato fundo ou tigela.
7) Polvilhe a cebolinha, a salsa e as sementes de gergelim cruas por cima da sopa pronta para manter a textura e as propriedades das ervas e sementes.
8) Torre a fatia de pão de forma e espalhe a manteiga . Sirva imediatamente ao lado da sopa quente.
